notes: Known issues, not discoveries of this report: the ~6x perplexity comes from the FFN graph using SiLU where BitNet b1.58 uses ReLU2 (microsoft/BitNet#588, reported 2026-07-19; also #602). The aarch64 garbage output starts at 112f853 (microsoft/BitNet#470, bisected 2026-03-15; layout fixes in #586, isHuangXin/llama.cpp#2, #633). None of the fixes were merged as of 2026-10-09.

What this report adds: a reference on the same token IDs (HF transformers, 18.7934); ik_llama.cpp (converted to iq2_bn_r4) matching it; bitnet.cpp 404980e (June 2025) matching it; current main + the one-line fix from #588 matching it on x86_64 (18.8676) and, with isHuangXin/llama.cpp#2, on aarch64 (18.8444); and an exact reproduction of the numbers published in #588.

ARM fixes in circulation, measured against the reference: isHuangXin/llama.cpp#2 + the #588 line fixes current main (18.8444); microsoft/BitNet#586 is correct on its March 2026 base (18.8515) but edits a file that current main no longer compiles; microsoft/BitNet#633 has no effect on current main (still ????). microsoft/BitNet#642 gave garbage in its first version (9dcd80d: no effect as merged; PPL 5.2e7 with its patch); its second version (241ce30, 2026-10-14) was correct on Neoverse-N1 with a static build (18.8444) but did not link with shared libraries; its third version (4cdf35a, 2026-10-15) is correct with static and shared-library builds on Neoverse-N1 (18.8444) and x86_64 AVX2 (18.8676), and on the scalar path of an ARMv8.0 build (18.8497). That src/ggml-bitnet-mad.cpp dropped out of the build was noted in microsoft/BitNet#626; the cause is the July 2026 submodule switch.

The GGUF has no tokenizer.ggml.pre; GGUF runtimes tokenize WikiText into ~16% more tokens than the HF tokenizer (1631 vs 1407 on the first 6000 bytes). The HF tokenizer gives PPL 15.3107 on its own tokens, which is not comparable to the rows above. Already noted in microsoft/BitNet#588 (override with tokenizer.ggml.pre=llama-bpe) and PR #508.
